proposal.reason: Main change is communicator configuration lifecycle: new comm config fields are validated/defaulted, overridden from env, stored on comm, and synchronized across ranks (nChannelsPerNetPeer, graphUsageMode, maxP2pPeers, plus accepted nvlinkCentricSched/numRmaCtx). Add enqueue because graphUsageMode now changes strong-stream/graph-capture behavior in enqueue/strongstream paths. Add device-topology because P2P per-peer channel computation now derives remote-net channels from topology bandwidth and max-peer budget, changing channel selection logic.
